L140: Sizing & Styling +

L142: 2 carat studs sit substantial on the lobe without overpowering it. The face up size of a 1 carat princess is approximately 5.5mm square, slightly smaller than a same carat round, which gives the studs a sharper, more concentrated look. One size fits all ear sizes.

L150: Buying these for a specific occasion? Email us your date at info@dracodiamond.com before or after ordering. We confirm in writing whether we can deliver in time. If we confirm and miss the date through our fault, the piece is yours free. Full refund. You keep it. No other lab diamond brand offers this in writing.
L151: Questions What is a princess cut? + Princess cut is a square or slightly rectangular shape with sharp 90 degree corners and brilliant cut faceting. It is the second most popular diamond cut after round, and the most popular non-round shape for studs and engagement rings. The angular geometry catches light differently than rounds, more concentrated flashes rather than diffuse sparkle. Will the corners chip? + The four corners of a princess cut are the most vulnerable point of the stone.
L152: Our four prong setting places one prong over each corner, which is the industry-standard way to shield them from impact. Treat them like fine jewelry, avoid sleeping or showering in them, and they will last generations. Lifetime warranty covers stone repair from manufacturing defect. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + Yes. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment.
L153: The FTC confirmed their equivalence in 2018. IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What are guardian backs? + Guardian backs are a secure earring closure with a flat backing disc that prevents the earring from sliding forward off the post. Combined with the screw or threaded post, they hold heavy stud earrings in place far better than standard friction backs. Standard on every Draco stud over 1 carat per ear.
L154: Which metal should I choose? + White gold and platinum let the diamonds do the work, the cleanest, most modern look. Yellow gold warms the stones and reads more vintage. Rose gold sits romantic. Platinum is the most hypoallergenic option, ideal for sensitive ears. Silver delivers the white gold effect at the lowest price point. L131: The hand that builds and the hand that grows are the same hand. A 3 carat radiant center, framed by marquise leaves and a band that twists like a vine. One 3.00 carat radiant cut lab diamond at center, 10.5 by 7.1 millimeters, E to F color, VS+ clarity, IGI certified. Sixteen marquise lab diamonds form leaf clusters along each shoulder. Fifty six round lab diamonds pavé set across a twisting infinity band, 0.30 carats total. 4.30 carats total weight. The radiant is the column. The marquise are the foliage.
L132: The band is the vine that holds them together. Architecture and garden in one ring.
L133: Made once, for you, in 2 to 3 weeks. Choose Silver, 10K, 14K, 18K Gold, or Platinum in white, yellow, or rose at checkout. Not pulled from inventory. Built to your order, verified against its IGI certificate before it ships. 3.00ct Radiant · 1.30ct Accents · 4.30ct TW · E-F color, VS+ clarity · IGI Certified · Silver · 10K · 14K · 18K Gold · Platinum

L143: 
L144: Full Specifications +
L145: Total carat weight 4.30ct Center stone 3.00ct radiant cut lab diamond Center dimensions 10.5 x 7.1 x 4.59mm Side stones 16 marquise lab diamonds, 1.00ct total Marquise sizes 10 pcs at 3 x 1.5mm, 6 pcs at 3.5 x 1.8mm Pavé band 56 round lab diamonds, 0.30ct total Diamond color E to F Diamond clarity VS+ Certification IGI, International Gemological Institute Setting Four prong center, marquise leaf clusters, pavé twist band Band width 2.7mm tapered Metal options Silver · 10K · 14K · 18K Gold · Platinum Metal colors White, yellow, or rose on all gold options Finish Rhodium coated high polish on white gold Production Made to order in 2 to 3 weeks
L146: Sizing & Styling +
L147: 
L148: Standard ring sizes 4 to 10 available. The pavé band can be resized within two sizes of the original cut, beyond that the integrity of the diamond setting is compromised. Specify your size at checkout. Free first resize within 60 days of delivery if you guessed wrong.
L149: Wears on the ring finger as engagement, anniversary, or right hand statement. The width and visual weight balance best on the dominant hand for right hand wear. Pairs with a plain band stacked above or below as a wedding set, ask us to make one to match.
L150: White gold and platinum keep the focus on the diamonds and the architectural lines. Yellow gold warms the radiant and reads more vintage. Rose gold sits romantic and flatters warm skin. Silver delivers the white gold effect at the lowest price point. Platinum is the most durable for daily wear and recommended for engagement use.
L151: Other jewelry should match the tone of this ring. Worn with simple studs, a thin necklace, or a watch. Skip large rings on the same hand, the radiant is the focal point and needs space around it.
L152: 
L153: Occasion Guarantee +
L154: Buying this for a specific occasion? Email us your date at info@dracodiamond.com before or after ordering. We confirm in writing whether we can deliver in time. If we confirm and miss the date through our fault, the piece is yours free. Full refund. You keep it. No other lab diamond brand offers this in writing.
L155: Questions Can this be worn as an engagement ring? + Yes. The 3 carat radiant center, IGI certified diamond, and traditional 4 prong setting meet every standard for an engagement ring. It also functions as a right hand statement ring, an anniversary ring, or a milestone piece. The design intentionally crosses categories so you can wear it on either hand and have it read correctly. A matching plain band can be paired with it as a wedding set on request.
L156: How does a radiant cut differ from emerald or princess? + Radiant combines the silhouette of an emerald cut (elongated rectangular shape with cropped corners) with the brilliant cut faceting of a round or princess. The result is the visual length of an emerald with the fire and sparkle of a round. It is the only step shape that scintillates like a brilliant. Developed in 1977 by Henry Grossbard, it has become a favorite of celebrities including Jennifer Lopez and Megan Fox.
L157: Will the twist band catch on things? + The 2.7mm tapered band sits flush against the finger without protruding ridges. The pavé diamonds are bead set into the band, not raised. The marquise leaf clusters on the shoulders sit angled inward, not outward. Hair, sweaters, and gloves do not catch in normal wear. We do recommend removing it for high impact activities like lifting weights or rock climbing.
L158: Can the center stone be resized or replaced later? + The ring itself can be resized within two sizes either direction. Upsizing or downsizing further would compromise the integrity of the pavé band and is not recommended. The center stone is replaceable at our workshop if you want to upgrade carat weight in future, charged at the difference in diamond cost plus a small reset fee. Email info@dracodiamond.com for the upgrade program.
L159: Which metal should I choose? + White gold and platinum let the radiant and marquise diamonds do the work, the cleanest, most modern look. Yellow gold warms the stones and reads more vintage. Rose gold sits romantic and pairs well with warmer skin tones. Platinum is the most durable for daily wear and never needs replating, ideal for an engagement ring. Silver delivers the white gold effect at the lowest price point. All gold options are solid 10K, 14K, or 18K, never plated.

L137: How to Wear It +
L138: Wear it against bare skin or over a high neckline for contrast. If you stack, go longer and plainer below it. A piece this deliberate earns its own space.

L144: Occasion Guarantee +

Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. In 2018 the FTC removed the word natural from its definition of a diamond.
L147: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath. Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw.
L148: Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone. Platinum is for people who buy once and never think about it again, dense, hypoallergenic, and never needs re plating. All options come in white, yellow, and rose gold.

L138: Not sure of your size? Message info@dracodiamond.com before ordering and a ring sizer ships to you free. One complimentary resize is included within 60 days of delivery.

L140: White gold sits cool against the stone and amplifies the sparkle. Yellow gold brings warmth. Rose gold sits between the two. Platinum is the heaviest and the most hypoallergenic. All options come in solid 10K, 14K, 18K.
L141: Care is simple. Warm water and a soft brush. Remove before lifting weights or working with harsh chemicals. The setting is designed for daily wear.

L145: Buying this for a specific occasion? Email us your date at info@dracodiamond.com before or after ordering. We confirm in writing whether we can deliver in time. If we confirm and miss the date through our fault, the piece is yours free. Full refund. You keep it.
L146: Questions Can the ring be resized? + Yes. One complimentary resize is included within 60 days of delivery. After that a small jeweler fee applies. Message info@dracodiamond.com to arrange. How do I know my size? + Email info@dracodiamond.com before ordering. A ring sizer ships to you free of charge anywhere in Canada or the United States. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds.
L147: A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. In 2018 the FTC removed the word natural from its definition of a diamond. IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath.
L148: Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw. Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone.

Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds.

IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath.
L155: Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw. Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone.

Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. In 2018 the FTC removed the word natural from its definition of a diamond.
L147: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath. Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw.

L139: How to Wear It +
L140: Wear it against bare skin or over a high neckline for contrast. If you stack, go longer and plainer below it. A piece this deliberate earns its own space.

L146: Occasion Guarantee +
L147: Buying this for a specific occasion? Email us your date at info@dracodiamond.com before or after ordering. We confirm in writing whether we can deliver in time. If we confirm and miss the date through our fault, the piece is yours free. Full refund. You keep it.
L148: Questions Can the length be customized? + Yes. Select your preferred length at checkout. If you need something specific, message us before ordering and we will build it exactly as needed. Are lab grown diamonds real diamonds? + They are diamonds. Lab grown diamonds are chemically, physically, and optically identical to mined diamonds. A gemologist cannot tell the difference without specialized equipment. In 2018 the FTC removed the word natural from its definition of a diamond.
L149: IGI grades them on the same cut, color, clarity, and carat scale as mined stones. The only difference is origin. What does the rhodium finish mean for maintenance? + Rhodium is a surface coating applied to white gold to enhance brightness and scratch resistance. It is standard on white gold jewelry and does not affect the solid gold setting underneath. Over years of daily wear the coating can thin. A jeweler can re plate it for a small fee. This is routine maintenance, not a flaw.
L150: Which metal should I choose? + Silver gives you the same bright white look as white gold at the lowest price point, a strong choice if you want the diamond to do the talking. 10K is the most durable for daily wear and where most customers land. 14K and 18K offer higher purity with a richer tone. Platinum is for people who buy once and never think about it again, dense, hypoallergenic, and never needs re plating. All options come in white, yellow, and rose gold.

L223: ## We are committed to making your entire experience a pleasant one, from ordering to delivery.
L224: Every Draco Diamond piece is built to last. Solid gold settings, not plated. Prongs set to hold. Clasps and links engineered for daily wear, not display. Each stone is IGI certified VS+ clarity minimum, E-F color, individually verified against its grading report before it ships. If a piece does not meet that standard, it does not leave. What arrives at your door is built the way a piece at this price point should be built — and backed by a Lifetime Authenticity Guarantee if it ever falls short.

This is how we guarantee you receive a new piece built to your exact specifications, not something pulled from inventory that has been handled before.
L230: Made to order does not mean harder to return. Our 30-day return window and full refund apply regardless of how your piece was produced. If it is not right, the return process is identical to any standard online purchase.
